item.title: ICON Solaren Signs Pact With RenewSys For 300 MW POE Encapsulant Supply
item.description: Indian solar module manufacturer ICON Solaren Power Technologies Pvt. Ltd. has signed a supply agreement with RenewSys India Pvt. Ltd. to procure 300 megawatts (MW) of POE encapsulants for its module manufacturing operations, the companies said. The supplies will be delivered between January and April 2026 and will support ICON Solaren’s large-scale solar module production plans. item.description: GameChange Solar said it has been selected to supply its Genius Tracker™ 1P system for the Khulis solar photovoltaic independent power plant in Saudi Arabia, being developed by ACWA Power. The project is being executed by a joint venture comprising China Energy Engineering Corp (CEEC), Guangdong Power Engineering Co (GPEC) and Northwest Electric Power Design Institute (NWEPDI) as engineering, procurement and construction (EPC) contractors. item.description: Bhubaneswar-based Climate tech startup, Aurassure that delivers real-time, hyperlocal visibility into environmental risks for enterprises operating in increasingly volatile climates, has raised Rs 25 Crore in Pre-Series A led by Rainmatter by Zerodha and Unicorn India Ventures. item.title: Suzlon, Yanara Extend Partnership with 306 MW Wind Projects for Rajasthan FDRE Portfolio
item.description: Suzlon Group and Yanara have extended their partnership with the signing of two new wind contracts of 153 MW each for Yanara’s firm and dispatchable renewable energy (FDRE) projects in Barmer, Rajasthan. In a press release, Suzlon said the latest projects have expanded its footprint in Rajasthan, where it has installed over 2.3 GW of wind capacity, translating into a 44% market share. item.title: Europe Turns Spotlight On Solar Inverters With Labelling As "High Risk Dependency'
item.description: After dodging strong protective action for a long time, the solar inverter market could be set for significant upheavals in the next few years worldwide outside China. In 2024, 9 of the top 10 solar inverter firms were from China, with Huawei and Sungrow together accounting for almost 55% of the market according to reports. item.title: ReNew, Google Enter Agreement for 150 MW Rajasthan Solar Project; C&I Portfolio Reaches 2.7 GW
item.description: Gurugram-based ReNew Energy Global Plc (ReNew) entered a long-term agreement with Google in India to develop a new 150 megawatt (MW) solar project in Rajasthan. In a press release, ReNew said the 150 MW solar project is scheduled for commissioning in 2026 and is expected to generate approximately 425,000 MWh of clean electricity annually. item.title: Korean Researchers Lift Efficiency Ceiling For Tin-Based Thin-Film Solar Cells
item.description: Researchers at Chonnam National University have overcome a long-standing performance bottleneck in tin monosulfide (SnS) thin-film solar cells by introducing an ultra-thin germanium oxide layer at the device’s rear contact, significantly improving efficiency and stability. item.title: US Energy Storage Installations Rise In Q3 2025, Outlook Mixed Amid Policy Uncertainty
item.description: The U.S. energy storage market continued to expand in the third quarter of 2025, with 5.3 gigawatts (GW) of capacity installed nationwide, lifting year-to-date additions above total installations recorded in all of 2024, according to the latest U.S. Energy Storage Monitor report released by the American Clean Power Association (ACP) and Wood Mackenzie.
